en.name: Hex ↔ Binary
en.short: Convert numbers and text between hex, binary, octal and decimal.

en.description: Convert numbers of any size between decimal, hexadecimal, binary and octal, and text to hex, binary or decimal UTF-8 bytes and back. 100% in your browser.
